text: In discussing the subclaim that there exists an efficient pair of models achieving an approximate global equilibrium of the game, the authors note that with computationally unbounded debaters, debate with optimal play (and cross-examination) can answer any question in NEXP given polynomial-time judges (Irving et al., 2018). They call the unbounded-debater assumption unrealistic and say a different, realistic efficiency notion is needed.
title: Unbounded-debater assumption behind Irving et al.'s complexity results called unrealistic
